outputText:
```yaml
synthesis:
  inspection_mode: "read-only file inspection; no commands or tests run; no files changed"
  current_subject:
    gm_sha: "3014239a0d22b21a3d2994fcc5f5b2da4e7e8236"
    verification: "coordinator-supplied HEAD/clean verification"
    input_bundle_sha256: "d93888d7a01fd438c4ca22035f872cb1c61e0c77ba0d92ce75345121b24ae532"
  evidence_subjects:
    integrator_base: "0f7d2fc64ae7258781e6c2676ca1e0ccc377f418"
    historical_inventory_subject: "e0388dc6a3dd72f114e83b41768f4ceefe7cc87c"
    dispute_subject: "2bef472612dea7c6a89199a47dd8ca7ed552e630"
    supplemental_analysis_subject: "fe9611590dae25cdc22887148d685889daa0f7c6"
    retained_api_execution_subject: "3155309a25edfd8d9dbb8b46e9c95259d9901357"
  accounting:
    historical_inventory: "110 raw; 97 byte-unique; 88 canonical roles; 9 attempts"
    evidence_states: "11 positive, 75 review-only, 5 source-unavailable, 4 partial, 2 blocked"
    supplement: "six new read-only analyses (O1-O5 and T2), not votes or runtime proof"
    api_result_sha256: "ec72ade37bc0e7342d879ff19c6f633493ecbce9520cbecdb15e589a22b18e76"

authority:
  order:
    - "Accepted ADR-0001..0008 and ADR-0015, ARCH-SYSTEM-BOUNDARY, GM-REQ-V1, and digest-pinned artifacts."
    - "ADR-0002-pinned organization Feature Module Standard."
    - "Active local mappings and enforcement."
    - "Current contract, roadmap, and implementation guide as derived guidance."
    - "ADR-0009..0014 and ADR-0016 as proposed only."
    - "Fixtures, workers, supplements, and this synthesis as non-authoritative evidence."
  many_contract:
    accepted: >
      required is exactly one; optional is zero or one; many is inclusive
      min..max in explicit profile order. required()/optional() return fresh
      mutable ordinary objects. many(options) performs ordinary property reads,
      including inherited min/max, copies the values unchanged into a fresh
      mutable ordinary result, performs no validation, and leaves min-versus-max
      evaluation order unspecified.
    security_boundary: >
      Getters and Proxies may throw, mutate, trap, or fail to terminate. The
      helper is trusted authoring convenience, not a security boundary. The
      compiler must validate min <= max and provider count.
  start_authority:
    product_approval: >
      ADR-0015 permits private source but does not authorize starting it.
      Only a repository-visible product-owner decision can do that; none is
      present. This is a product decision state, not evidence of a semantic defect.
    technical_preflight: >
      Independently, admission must consume the authorization and reject missing,
      stale, wrong-base, wrong-package, and over-broad records, while enforcing
      @get-modular/core, uniqueness, private:true, and no publication fields.
      A checker cannot grant product approval, and approval cannot substitute for
      these technical checks.
    research_completion: >
      GO. Missing implementation subjects and retained NO-GO phase gates limit
      claims but do not block completing the research synthesis.

findings:
  - id: "I1-AUTH-01"
    severity: "P1"
    class: "current governance/documentation defect"
    evidence:
      - "gm-dispute-t8-r1-2bef-20260904"
      - "gm-dispute-t8-r3-2bef-20260904"
      - "gm-final-4dee-r1-authority-20260903/F-AUTH-001"
      - "research/implementation-readiness/report.md/AUTH-01"
    impact: >
      First-package admission has no closed owner-start record input or validation
      contract. A valid-looking private package could pass without proving that
      the product owner authorized this repository, base, package, and scope.
    minimal_correction: >
      Specify a closed record bound non-self-referentially to the authorized base,
      package, owner, normalized-only scope, and exclusions; separately obtain
      owner approval; define negative admission cases.
    owner_authority: "Product owner approves; architecture/governance defines enforcement under ADR-0015."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "Blocks tracked Core source, not research or a documentation-only Phase 0 packet."

  - id: "I1-GOV-02"
    severity: "P1"
    class: "future promotion blocker"
    evidence: ["gm-readiness-a2-lane-l-20260903", "report.md/GOV-01"]
    impact: >
      The current profile checker requires structural and runtime states to stay
      not-claimed and cannot validate the documented ordered promotion.
    minimal_correction: "Specify and later restore not-claimed -> structural-conformant -> runtime-conformant validation."
    owner_authority: "Architecture/conformance owner."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No; blocks structural/runtime promotion."

  - id: "I1-GOV-03"
    severity: "P2"
    class: "latent admission blocker"
    evidence:
      - "gm-final-4dee-r1-authority-20260903/F-GOV-001"
      - "gm-dispute-t8-r1-2bef-20260904"
      - "report.md/GOV-02"
    impact: "Unknown package identity can be accepted after the open-decision blocker set becomes empty."
    minimal_correction: "Make manifest identity, uniqueness, private:true, and publication-field restrictions unconditional."
    owner_authority: "Architecture/governance under ADR-0003 and ADR-0015."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "Not today; must close before blocker retirement."

  - id: "I1-SC-01"
    severity: "P2"
    class: "authority-label documentation gap"
    evidence:
      - "mvp-implementation-roadmap.md:95,565-571"
      - "self-composition-implementation-guide.md:33-34,731-758,821"
      - "ADR-0008:69-77,282-296"
      - "ADR-0016:90-102"
    impact: >
      The M3 table names ADR-0016 without saying “acceptance of,” while the guide
      permits candidate implementation without a claim. This can be misread as
      proposed ADR-0016 already replacing accepted ADR-0008.
    minimal_correction: >
      Say explicitly: ADR-0008 is current claim authority; experimental ADR-0016
      rules remain replaceable and unclaimable; a static witness becomes authority
      only after ADR-0016 or another successor is accepted.
    owner_authority: "Architecture documentation; product owner for successor acceptance."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No; blocks an unambiguous M3 handoff."

  - id: "I1-SC-02"
    severity: "P1"
    class: "future self-composition blocker"
    evidence:
      - "ADR-0008:282-296"
      - "self-composition-implementation-guide.md:579-584"
      - "gm-final-4dee-r1-authority-20260903/F-DETERMINISM-001"
    impact: >
      ADR-0008 requires exact P0/P1, digest, and W0/W1 artifact equality, but the
      emitted W format and independent byte-checking procedure are not closed.
    minimal_correction: >
      Define the exact emitted artifact format, normalization, isolated locations,
      and independent byte comparison. Do not replace W0/W1 with path-independent
      tuples merely because a historical reviewer recommended that; doing so needs
      successor authority.
    owner_authority: "Architecture/product decision owner."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No for direct M1 semantics; yes for Phase 4/self-composed claims."

  - id: "I1-STRUCT-01"
    severity: "P1"
    class: "future structural-conformance blocker"
    evidence:
      - "gm-final-4dee-r1-authority-20260903/F-AUTH-004"
      - "self-composition-implementation-guide.md feature-skeleton rules"
    impact: >
      The guide's cross-feature value import of provider identity constants is a
      proposed exception and is not yet admitted by Foundation source-dependency policy.
    minimal_correction: "Obtain explicit policy authority for metadata-only edges or remove those imports from the claimed structure."
    owner_authority: "Architecture/Foundation."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No for isolated normalized algorithms; yes for structural self-composition."

  - id: "I1-QUAL-01"
    severity: "P1"
    class: "future declaration/profile qualification blocker"
    evidence:
      - "gm-readiness-a4-seq-20260903"
      - "gm-readiness-a5-seq-20260903"
      - "gm-pr16-bounded-t2-fe96115"
    impact: >
      The schema admits min:4,max:2, and retained fixtures lack a real-subject
      optional/zero/min/interior/max/over-max matrix.
    minimal_correction: >
      Put min <= max in semantic validation with accepted diagnostics and exercise
      all boundaries through the eventual real subject. Preserve ordinary and
      inherited helper reads; own-data enforcement would require a successor.
    owner_authority: "Core semantics and qualification owners."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No for start; yes for Phase 2/3 exit."

  - id: "I1-QUAL-02"
    severity: "P1"
    class: "future resource qualification blocker"
    evidence: ["gm-readiness-a5-seq-20260903", "gm-readiness-a6-seq-20260903", "report.md/QUAL-01"]
    impact: >
      Current resource oracles count Einput before selected-consumer filtering,
      detect many by literal slot name, report numeric depth for cycles, and omit
      profile bytes from document-batch accounting.
    minimal_correction: "Correct the oracle and add at-limit/plus-one and overlap vectors after diagnostic-precedence authority is closed."
    owner_authority: "Qualification owner; architecture/product owns unresolved precedence."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No for source start; yes for Phase 3 qualification."

  - id: "I1-API-01"
    severity: "P2"
    class: "current fixture labeling gap"
    evidence:
      - "api-authoring-exact-run.json/S21"
      - "common/run.mjs exactTitles"
      - "gm-dispute-t6-r1-2bef-20260904"
    impact: >
      S21 is still titled “duplicate module IDs” although repeated moduleId is
      legal; the actual failure is duplicate profile selection. The corrected
      oracle and six alternate-selection probes behave properly.
    minimal_correction: "Rename S21 to repeated/duplicate profile selection without changing its corrected semantics."
    owner_authority: "API qualification owner."
    blocks_next_safe_step: "No."

worker_contradictions:
  - dispute: "T2 R3 proposed own-data/trusted literals; other critics differed."
    resolution: "Supplement gm-pr16-bounded-t2-fe96115 follows ADR-0007: inherited ordinary reads remain accepted; critic counts are not votes."
  - dispute: "Integrators said CONDITIONAL private Core; T8 critics said NO-GO."
    resolution: "Semantic design is conditional; actual source landing is NO-GO until separate product approval and technical admission preflight."
  - dispute: "Historical F-DETERMINISM-001 recommended path-independent wiring tuples."
    resolution: "Rejected under current authority: ADR-0008 requires exact W0/W1 artifacts."
  - dispute: "Historical O1-O5 were source-unavailable."
    resolution: "Their frozen status remains; six fe96115 supplements close research inspection lanes only."
  - dispute: "Older S21 rejected legal alternative implementations."
    resolution: "Current retained source corrects selection semantics; only the title remains misleading."

phase_readiness:
  - { phase: "0 contract/evidence preflight", status: "GO for non-Core work; exit NO-GO", reason: "owner decision and admission contract absent" }
  - { phase: "1 private package boundary", status: "NO-GO now; CONDITIONAL after Phase 0", reason: "private normalized seam only" }
  - { phase: "2 declarations/profiles/slots", status: "NO-GO exit", reason: "real subject and cardinality matrix absent" }
  - { phase: "3 normalization/graph", status: "NO-GO qualification", reason: "resource oracle defects and diagnostic decisions" }
  - { phase: "4 plan/digest/self-composition", status: "NO-GO", reason: "no subject; ADR-0008 identity and W0/W1 proof absent" }
  - { phase: "5 conformance/scale", status: "NO-GO", reason: "no packed compiler, full security/resource or six-runtime-case evidence" }
  - { phase: "6 product dogfood", status: "NO-GO/not entered", reason: "product Host lifecycle and failure policy are outside Core" }
  - { phase: "7 plugin boundary", status: "reserved/no gate", reason: "outside current scope" }
  - { phase: "8 publication", status: "NO-GO", reason: "public/carrier/release decisions and custody remain open" }

api_candidate_comparison:
  retained_scope: >
    Source 3155309 only: 30 scenarios x 3 candidates = 90 outcomes; 18
    before/after experiments = 36 emitted source trees. All candidates used the
    same ten-declaration feature-local topology and changed [4,1,4,3,1,1] files
    for add, rebind, remove-repaired, remove-unrepaired, disable-required,
    disable-optional.
  candidates:
    - { id: "descriptor-object", authoring_loc: 4, total_support_loc: 12, lab_generic_glue_ratio: 0.75, dts_bytes: 181, serialized_bytes: 22048 }
    - { id: "define-module", authoring_loc: 4, total_support_loc: 27, lab_generic_glue_ratio: 0.8709677419, dts_bytes: 543, serialized_bytes: 21898 }
    - { id: "split-declaration-factory", authoring_loc: 5, total_support_loc: 24, lab_generic_glue_ratio: 0.8275862069, dts_bytes: 338, serialized_bytes: 25540 }
  probes: >
    Six alternative-provider selections succeeded. Factories were restricted to
    S27/S28 host-probe cells (six candidate×probe uses), not semantic discovery.
    Split association had only two probes: valid association and mismatched
    identity rejection; closed dependency typing was compile-time evidence.
  conclusion: >
    Prefer inert descriptor data, optionally wrapped by exact-reference
    defineModule, with separate feature-owned Pure DI factories. This is private
    design evidence, not a public API selection. Ratios are lab-specific; runtime,
    tree-shaking, navigation, developer time, and product edit costs were not measured.

oss_lessons:
  - { source: "VS Code 400d86b", lesson: "separate inert contribution metadata from activation", reject: "case-folded IDs, activation registry, restart policy in Core" }
  - { source: "Theia 5358262", lesson: "snapshot scope/lifetime and cleanup costs explicitly", reject: "container order and catch-and-continue compiler semantics" }
  - { source: "Equinox 6172b52", lesson: "dependency order is not activation policy", reject: "mutable wiring, dynamic loading, auto-start" }
  - { source: "Effect bd393d6", lesson: "required/provided typing and explicit host lifetimes", reject: "Layer execution, Context lookup, object identity as module identity" }
  - { source: "Avvio 52f5cbb", lesson: "boot, timeout and close behavior belongs to the Host", reject: "registration order, inherited runtime context, timeout-as-cancellation" }

unresolved_product_decisions:
  - "Whether and when the product owner authorizes the private normalized Core start."
  - "Retain an ADR-0008 object-identity witness mapping or accept/revise ADR-0016's static/behavioral replacement."
  - "ADR-0009..0014 and OD-004..006: public names, adapters, carrier, raw/trusted boundary, and repeated records."
  - "ADR-0011 release custody."
  - "Resource/schema precedence, path-segment counting, and cyclic-depth result."
  - "Public unknown-field/readonly typing."
  - "Future product-Host failure, cleanup, retry, readiness, recovery, and retirement policy."

verdict:
  research_synthesis: "GO"
  first_tracked_private_core_now: "NO-GO"
  after_product_approval_and_technical_preflight: "CONDITIONAL for private normalized-value source only"
  public_runtime_self_composed_release_claims: "NO-GO"

minimal_dependency_safe_next_task:
  action: >
    Prepare and route one Phase 0 authority packet, without implementing Core or
    a checker: define the closed, non-self-referential owner-start record and its
    negative validation criteria; ask the product owner for an explicit yes/no
    decision; if approved, bind repository, authorized base, @get-modular/core,
    owner, normalized-only scope, and exclusions. Checker implementation and
    exact-head gate execution are separate later work.
```
